import mir_eval

# Precondition: Trim or pad the estimate to match reference timing
adj_ref_intervals, adj_ref_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
    ref_intervals, ref_labels, t_min=0.0
)
adj_est_intervals, adj_est_labels = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
    est_intervals, est_labels, t_min=0.0, t_max=adj_ref_intervals.max()
)

# Compute pair-wise agreement metrics
precision, recall, f = mir_eval.segment.pairwise(
    adj_ref_intervals, 
    adj_ref_labels, 
    adj_est_intervals, 
    adj_est_labels,
    frame_size=0.1,
    beta=1.0
)

# Verify metrics are within valid probability bounds
assert 0.0 <= precision <= 1.0, f"Precision {precision} out of bounds"
assert 0.0 <= recall <= 1.0, f"Recall {recall} out of bounds"
assert 0.0 <= f <= 1.0, f"F-measure {f} out of bounds"

# Verify the F-measure relationship (harmonic mean of precision and recall for beta=1.0)
if precision + recall > 0:
    expected_f = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
    assert abs(f - expected_f) < 1e-6, f"F-measure {f} does not match expected {expected_f}"
elif precision == 0 and recall == 0:
    assert f == 0.0, "F-measure should be 0 when both precision and recall are 0"

print(f"__CHECK__ pairwise {precision:.4f}, {recall:.4f}, {f:.4f}")
